user.title: Set up the local receiver
user.description: Listen for UDP from the Moxa. This does not configure the Moxa or verify the pump connection. Configure the Moxa destination to this Home Assistant host and local UDP port. New entries start in observation-only mode.

data.source_port: Moxa source UDP port (0 accepts any)

reconfigure.title: Change receiver network settings
reconfigure.description: Change the local UDP listener and expected Moxa sender. This reloads the integration and keeps the selected decoder profile. It does not configure the Moxa or verify the pump connection.

data.source_port: Moxa source UDP port (0 accepts any)

error.invalid_network: Enter numeric unicast IPv4 addresses and valid ports. The local listening address may be 0.0.0.0.
error.source_already_configured: An entry already receives this Moxa source. Reconfigure the existing entry.
error.bind_conflict: Another ComfortZone entry uses an overlapping local listening address and port. Choose a separate local port.

init.title: Decoder and freshness
init.description: Observation only preserves diagnostic frames without creating measurements. The RX50 reference layout is provisional: its mapping and fault values have not been validated on this EX35. Select it only for comparison with real captures and pump readings. All times below are seconds.

data.gap_timeout: Reset partial data after a source gap

error.invalid_options: Check the time limits. The source-gap timeout must be at least the incomplete-frame timeout.
